answer: Anti-Sybil equilibrium binds identity to capital: an attacker deploying n validators faces super-linear expenditure, c n^2, while quadratic slashing, s n^2, erodes posted collateral in a plume of irreversible burn. The garden of honest stake deepens the tide, so marginal cost rises faster than potential extracted value; once n exceeds threshold T = sqrt(V/s), guaranteed loss exceeds V.
